initialization_sequence: 1. Apply VDD and VDDQ (single ramp from the same regulator); maintain RESET# ≤ 0.2 × VDD and CKE LOW throughout the ramp.

2. VDD ramp from 300 mV to VDDmin shall complete within ≤ 200 ms; the additional constraint VDD > VDDQ AND (VDD − VDDQ) < 0.3 V applies during ramp; VTT ≤ 0.95 V max once power ramp is finished; VREF tracks VDDQ/2.
3. Maintain RESET# LOW for ≥ 200 µs after stable power; maintain CKE LOW (≥ 10 ns) before RESET# deassertion.
4. Deassert RESET# (drive HIGH); wait 500 µs (tINIT3) until CKE may go active. DRAM begins internal state initialization independent of external CK during this window.
5. Start CK / CK# — clocks need ≥ 10 ns or 5 nCK of stable clocking before CKE rises. NOP or DESELECT must be registered with tIS setup before CKE goes HIGH.
6. Raise CKE HIGH (registered HIGH with tIS to CK); maintain ODT static throughout init (LOW if RTT_Nom will be enabled, HIGH/LOW otherwise).
7. Wait tXPR = max(tXS, 5 nCK) after CKE rising before issuing the first MRS.
8. MRS to MR2 with application settings (CWL, SRT, Rtt_WR). Wait tMRD.
9. MRS to MR3 (MPR disabled). Wait tMRD.
10. MRS to MR1 (DLL Enable=0, Rtt_Nom, AL, output driver, Write Leveling=0). Wait tMRD.
11. MRS to MR0 with all application settings AND DLL Reset (A8=1). Wait tMOD.
12. Issue ZQCL command. Wait both tDLLK (512 nCK) and tZQinit (512 nCK) before the first data command. DRAM is now ready for normal operation.
reset_with_stable_power_sequence: 1. Assert RESET# LOW below 0.2 × VDD for ≥ 100 ns; CKE pulled LOW (≥ 10 ns before RESET# deassert).
single_bank_read_sequence_BL8: 1. Verify target bank is precharged (or just activated).
2. Issue ACT command with bank address BA[2:0] and row address on A[15:0]; wait tRCD.
3. Issue RD command with column address on A[0:9] (x4 uses A11 too) and A10/AP=L (no autoprecharge), A12/BC#=H (BL8 if MR0 enables OTF).
4. Wait RL = AL + CL cycles. DRAM drives DQS preamble (tRPRE) starting at RL−1, then 8 beats of DQ edge-aligned with DQS.
5. Capture 8 beats from DQ on both edges of DQS; verify against expected data.
6. Optionally issue PRE after tRTP from the RD command, or RDA in step 3 for automatic precharge.
single_bank_write_sequence_BL8: 1. Verify target bank is precharged (or just activated).
3. Issue WR command with column address; A10/AP=L (no autoprecharge), A12/BC#=H (BL8).
4. Wait WL = AL + CWL cycles. Drive DQS preamble (tWPRE) starting at WL−1, then 8 beats of DQ centred in DQS.
5. Drive DM HIGH on the DQS edges where data shall be masked.
6. After tWR (from last data beat), issue PRE; or WRA in step 3 for automatic precharge with tWR + tRP applied.
multi_bank_interleave_sequence: 1. ACT bank0 row0 → wait tRRD → ACT bank1 row0 → wait tRRD → ACT bank2 row0 → wait tRRD → ACT bank3 row0 (total ≤ tFAW from bank0 ACT).
2. RD bank0 → tCCD (4 nCK) → RD bank1 → tCCD → RD bank2 → tCCD → RD bank3 (round-robin column access).
3. Capture per-bank read bursts back-to-back; DRAM hides tRCD via Additive Latency if AL=CL-1 or CL-2.
4. PRE all banks (PREA) → wait tRP → next round of activations.
refresh_sequence: 1. Track elapsed time since last REF; target average tREFI (7.8 µs normal, 3.9 µs extended).
2. When all banks are precharged with tRP satisfied, issue REF.
3. Wait tRFC(min) before next valid command except NOP/DES (tRFC depends on density: 90/110/160/260/350 ns for 512Mb/1Gb/2Gb/4Gb/8Gb).
4. May postpone up to 8 REFs (max 9 × tREFI between two surrounding REFs); may pull in up to 8 REFs.
5. Before Self-Refresh entry, execute all postponed REFs.
self_refresh_entry_exit_sequence: 1. Bring DRAM to All-Banks-Idle: PREA → wait tRP → no in-flight bursts.
2. Drive ODT LOW (or disable RTT_Nom via MR1 prior to entry); maintain LOW throughout SR.
3. Issue SRE (CKE LOW with CS#=L, RAS#=L, CAS#=L, WE#=H); DRAM internally generates ≥ 1 refresh and enters SR.
4. Optionally stop external CK after tCKSRE (10 ns / 5 nCK).
5. To exit: restart CK and let it stabilize for ≥ tCKSRX before CKE rising; on CKE rising, NOP/DES on command bus.
6. Wait tXS (= tRFC + 10 ns) before any command not requiring DLL; wait tXSDLL (= tDLLK = 512 nCK) before a command requiring DLL.
7. Issue one extra REF before re-entering SR (covers the internal refresh timer drift during SR).
8. Optionally issue ZQCL after tXS to recalibrate output drivers / ODT.
write_leveling_sequence: 2. Disable output buffers (MR1 A12=1 Qoff) on all ranks except the rank being levelled.
3. Enter WL mode: MRS MR1 A7=1 on target rank; wait tMOD.
4. Controller asserts ODT (after MOD has expired); wait tDQSL / tWLDQSEN.
5. Controller drives a single DQS / DQS# pulse asynchronously after tWLO.
6. DRAM samples CK / CK# on the rising DQS edge and drives the sampled level on a prime DQ bit (or all DQ).
7. Controller captures the DQ feedback; if 0, increase DQS delay; if 1 (and previous was 0), the 0→1 transition marks the target alignment.
8. Repeat for each byte lane (x16 has separate upper / lower DQS feedback).
9. Exit WL: MRS MR1 A7=0 on target rank; wait tMOD; restore Qoff if needed.
mpr_read_training_sequence: 1. Bring DRAM to All-Banks-Idle with tRP satisfied.
2. Issue MRS MR3 with A2=1 and A[1:0]=00 (predefined pattern). Wait tMRD and tMOD.
3. Issue RD or RDA with A[1:0]=00 (burst order 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 for BL8), A2=0, A12/BC#=1.
4. Capture 8-beat read on DQ; DQ[0] of every byte lane carries the predefined pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1]; DQ[7:1] either drive the same pattern or all-zeros.
5. Sweep the controller's DQ sampling phase across the bit-period to find the pass window; pick window centre.
6. Exit MPR mode: MRS MR3 with A2=0; wait tMOD before normal commands.
zq_calibration_sequence: 1. Bring DRAM to All-Banks-Idle with tRP satisfied.
2. Disable ODT (drive ODT pin LOW) on all DRAMs whose ZQ window will overlap.
3. Issue ZQCL (long calibration). DQ must remain Hi-Z; no command other than NOP/DES on the affected DRAMs.
4. Wait tZQinit (≥ 512 nCK) if this is the first ZQCL after reset; wait tZQoper (≥ 256 nCK) otherwise.
5. For periodic short calibration: issue ZQCS; wait tZQCS (≥ 64 nCK). Run every ~128 ms at typical T/V drift (or shorter under high drift).
dll_off_entry_sequence: 2. While in SR, issue MRS MR1 A0=1 to disable DLL. Wait tMOD.
3. Change CK frequency to a value ≤ tCKDLL_OFF (vendor-defined; typically ≤ 125 MHz).
4. Exit SR; CL=6 and CWL=6 only; tDQSCK is vendor-defined and may exceed tCK.
power_down_entry_exit_sequence: 1. From Bank Active: CKE LOW + NOP/DES → Active Power-Down. Exit: CKE HIGH + tXP.
2. From All-Banks-Idle with MR0 A12=1: CKE LOW → Precharge Power-Down Fast Exit. Exit: CKE HIGH + tXP.
3. From All-Banks-Idle with MR0 A12=0: CKE LOW → Precharge Power-Down Slow Exit (DLL frozen). Exit: CKE HIGH + tXPDLL.
input_clock_frequency_change_sequence: Allowed ONLY in Self-Refresh OR Precharge Power-Down. Outside these modes the clock must remain stable within jitter/SSC limits.
Self-Refresh path: enter SR → wait tCKSRE → change frequency → wait stable clock ≥ tCKSRX → exit SR.

Precharge Power-Down path: enter PPD → wait tCKSRE → change frequency while ODT held LOW and CKE held LOW → exit PPD with new stable clock → may need MRS to retune CL/CWL/WR + DLL Reset for the new frequency.
